==============================================================================
ENGINE SETUP
==============================================================================

Three folders, because an engine and a DAW want different files. Pick the one
that matches what you are doing; you do not need all of them.

  Masters_24bit_Stereo    24-bit/48kHz stereo   editing in a DAW
  Engine_16bit/Mono_3D    16-bit mono           positioned in world
  Engine_16bit/Stereo_2D  16-bit stereo         UI and ambience

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WHY THE MONO FOLDER EXISTS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A stereo file cannot be spatialised. Unity, Unreal and Godot generate
panning, distance attenuation and reverb send from where a source sits in the
world. Hand any of them a stereo asset and that path is bypassed: it plays
flat across both speakers regardless of where the object is. So every sound a
game places in space ships mono, and the engine builds the stereo image at
runtime.

UI and ambience are never positioned, so they stay stereo.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
UNITY
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  1. Drop Engine_16bit/ into Assets/Audio/
  2. Per-clip import settings:
       Load Type ........... Decompress On Load (under ~1 second)
                             Compressed In Memory (longer beds)
       Compression Format .. PCM for short, frequent sounds
                             Vorbis for beds and long risers
       Force To Mono ....... OFF. Mono_3D is already mono, and
                             forcing it on Stereo_2D flattens
                             width that is really there.
       Sample Rate ......... Preserve Sample Rate
  3. On the AudioSource, set Spatial Blend to 3D for anything
     from Mono_3D/. A mono clip at 2D blend wastes the reason it
     is mono.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
UNREAL ENGINE
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  1. Drag the folder into the Content Browser. WAV imports
     directly to USoundWave.
  2. Attach a Sound Attenuation asset to anything from Mono_3D/.
     Without one, Unreal plays the sound non-spatialised no
     matter where the actor is.
  3. Group sounds with Sound Classes matching the top-level
     folders for one mix bus per category.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
GODOT 4
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  1. Copy into res://audio/. WAV imports with no conversion.
  2. Import dock: Loop off (these are one-shots), Force/8 Bit
     off, Compress Mode Disabled for short sounds or Vorbis/QOA
     for beds.
  3. AudioStreamPlayer3D for Mono_3D/, AudioStreamPlayer for
     Stereo_2D/.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FMOD STUDIO
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  1. Point your project's asset folder at Engine_16bit/.
  2. FMOD reads the embedded BWF/iXML metadata, so descriptions
     and categories appear in the asset browser without the CSV.
  3. Put Mono_3D/ sounds in events with a spatialiser. The 3D
     panner needs a mono input to place the source properly.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WWISE
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  1. Import via the Audio File Importer, or drive a batch import
     from manifest.csv.
  2. Set Conversion Settings per folder rather than per file.
  3. Mono_3D/ on 3D positioning: Emitter. Stereo_2D/ on 2D.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FILENAMES
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  CATEGORY_FxNameVnn_CREATOR_SOURCE.wav
  e.g. IMPT_MetalLargev01_BLDM_PSFX01.wav

ASCII only, no spaces, no characters that are illegal on Windows, nothing
that collides case-insensitively, and no path longer than 104 characters. The
library imports cleanly on Windows, macOS and Linux and survives a build
pipeline that rewrites paths.

The structure follows the Universal Category System convention
(CatID_FXName_CreatorID_SourceID), but the category codes are this library's
own and are listed in manifest.csv. They are not certified UCS CatIDs and are
not presented as such.
